desc: Ideation: Analyzed problem constraints and identified Segment Tree as the optimal approach ($O(N \log N)$).
Implement the Segment Tree class/functions to store and merge the required statistics (`max_sub`, `max_pref`, `max_suff`, `total`).
Build the tree over the input array `nums` (padding to power of 2).
Precompute a dictionary mapping each unique number to its list of indices.
Initialize `ans` with the global maximum subarray sum.
Iterate through each unique number $x$, identify segments, query the tree, and update `ans`.
Run the code against Example 1: `nums = [-3,2,-2,-1,3,-2,3]`. Expected: 7.
Run the code against Example 2: `nums = [1,2,3,4]`. Expected: 10.
